pages.name: Dashboard

pages.name: Products
pages.about: Product catalog: SKUs, variants, pricing; New item opens the create modal.

guide.finishLine: The product catalog list is open. For 'add product', also open New item — then stop; do not fill the form unless asked.

steps.do: Expand Items in the left sidebar if needed.
Click Products.
Only if they asked to add/create: click New item on the products page (not header CREATE unless they asked for quick create).
